{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is that all?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please make sure you eat properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, I will. {fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a taste you can never forget?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}A taste I can never forget...? Right now... I'd rather not remember.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like eating with a big crowd?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not so much now... I used to, once.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I do hope that someday those days will come back...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's share a meal together someday.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes... If the chance comes... I'd be glad to.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Make sure you eat well, all right?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you get to eat something good?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, very. If you haven't eaten yet, Angel, why don't you go and have something?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Mealtimes are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I think so too, but eating alone is a dreary thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, not especially. It's all right for now, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, I'm not that tired. I was just taking a little rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

Not that I mind...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}When I was little, I was a real tomboy. I ran around the courtyard and climbed trees, just like a boy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you get to relax?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, thank you. I took a leisurely walk around the area.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}The peaceful scenery, people's smiles... It eased my heart a little.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I stay with you for a little while?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes, I don't mind. I was wishing for someone to talk to.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Interesting? Nothing lately...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Not these days...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you. I'm getting a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}It's less that I like it, and more that I've grown used to it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes... thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's perfect weather for a nap.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes, it is... It's so warm and pleasant.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
